text: The directed path space in Simplicial TT from a to b is written hom_A(a,b). Unlike HoTT paths, these morphisms:
choices: May not be reversible (they are directed morphisms, not symmetric paths)
Are the same as paths when A is a Rezk type
explanation: Directed morphisms are not symmetric in general; an equivalence in a Segal type is a morphism with a two-sided inverse.
